about: Sega Rally Championship's own renderer: a list of textured polygons and sprite rectangles per layer, sorted far to near and filled without perspective into a 176 by 208 buffer of 12-bit pixels, which is then copied into the bitmap the HUD is drawn on.

hooks.note: The scene's first pass: clears the 3D buffer to 0x8000 (nothing drawn) and draws the first of three polygon layers. r0 the scene, u32(r0 + 4) the renderer; its 3D buffer of 12-bit pixels is at +0x8778.
Copies the 3D buffer, pixel by pixel and leaving out those with bit 15 set, into the bitmap the HUD is then drawn on.

A clipped polygon in screen space, about to be cut into edges: 16-bit texture, opaque. r6 the u32(sp) corners, 32 bytes each (x, y in 22.10 pixels; u, v at +16, +20 in 22.10 texels). The game samples at a pixel's lower right corner.

A clipped polygon in screen space, about to be cut into edges: 8-bit texture with a palette of 12-bit colours, opaque (not seen). r6 the u32(sp) corners, 32 bytes each (x, y in 22.10 pixels; u, v at +16, +20 in 22.10 texels). The game samples at a pixel's lower right corner.
A rectangle (a sprite: trees, signs): the game fills it between two opposite corners, the first and third when the first two share a row, else the fourth and second.
The rectangle, 16-bit texture, opaque, as a fan of four corners: A, (B.x, A.y), B, (A.x, B.y).
The rectangle, 8-bit texture with a palette of 12-bit colours, opaque (not seen), as a fan of four corners: A, (B.x, A.y), B, (A.x, B.y).

When replacing: one edge of an opaque polygon (r3 the mode), which on the second edge of a row fills the span between them. Not run. Modes 5 and 6 (transparent texels: trees, signs, barriers) are left to the game: the key colour would cover the panorama behind their see-through texels.
When replacing: fills an opaque rectangle (r3 the mode). Not run.
